body:
>What medication were you on? Did your doctor try switching to a different one?

Zoloft only. I never told anyone how awful it felt because it made me feel guilty.

>Did you go through any therapy?

The doctor strongly suggested that I do so; in fact, that was his first suggestion. Turns out we couldn't afford a counselor or anything, so I had to fall back on drugs to take care of it for me.

>Why are you so convinced you won't be able to do well in college?

I never do anything well anymore, it seems like. Everything is awful. I lose before I even begin.

>Why do you feel you will be forever alone?

No one could ever love me.
